projects.title: HousiFi - Realestate Tokenization
projects.description: Fractional real estate investment on Sepolia. Users pool a down payment by buying a majority (85%) or minority (15%) share of a property. Ownership and payouts are settled on-chain via ERC-20 property tokens and USDC.

projects.title: Domino - A Supply Chain Vulnerability Dashboard
projects.description: Models how disruptions to global commodity trade propagate through production chains and affect countries worldwide. Built on eleven years of bilateral trade data (~100 million rows) with a four-step cascade simulation across 23,760 shock scenarios. Spark on Google Cloud Dataproc with GraphFrames, an async FastAPI service on MongoDB Atlas, and a React/D3.js frontend centered on a rotatable 3D globe.

projects.title: Erica - A Text-based AI Tutor
projects.description: Uses a GraphRAG pipeline with knowledge graphs and LLMs for query retrieval and explanation generation, implementing end-to-end ingestion, graph construction, and subgraph-based query answering over multimodal course content.

projects.title: Automatic Number Plate Recognition
projects.description: A deep learning system that uses MobileNet CNN, TensorFlow and an object detection model to read number plates and achieved an accuracy of 92% on images with poor lighting, glare and obstructions.

projects.title: AI enabled B2B Full-Stack Fintech Application
